name: Howmet Aerospace Inc. (HWM)
product: Demand comes from patented single-crystal and directionally solidified turbine airfoils with advanced cooling and coatings for jet engines and industrial gas turbines, plus aerospace fasteners (CAM, Brunner) and forged aluminum truck wheels, per 2026-03-10 Technology and Markets Day (SEC ex99.1) and 2026-08-06 results (8-K ex99.1).
demand: Volume-led. Q2 2026 revenue rose 24% with organic growth 21%, driven by commercial aerospace plus 28%, gas turbines plus 38% and defense plus 11% (2026-08-06, 8-K ex99.1). Forged Wheels is the exception: revenue plus 14% on aluminum and inflation pass-through despite 8% lower commercial transportation volumes (2026-08-06, 8-K).
pricing_power: Aluminum and inflation pass-through in Forged Wheels, ramp and mix inefficiency from new capacity and CAM absorption, a prolonged commercial transportation trough, and tariff or trade disruption, all flagged as risks (2026-08-06, 8-K ex99.1). Q2 2026 Adjusted EBITDA margin was 32.1%; a slide toward 30% would signal erosion.
competition: Not found. Howmet calls itself the largest gas-turbine blade manufacturer in the world with patented single-crystal, cooling and coating technology (2026-03-10 TMD, SEC ex99.1). Chinese fastener and forging suppliers exist but aerospace OEM qualification is the barrier; no qualified low-cost airfoil substitute was identified.
market_strategy: 2026-08-06 John Plant: we already see the need to increase capex further in 2027 to support future organic growth, and guided FY2026 revenue 10.0-10.1B and Adjusted EPS 5.23-5.31 (8-K ex99.1). 2026-03-10: gas turbines to exceed 2B in the next 3 to 5 years (SEC TMD ex99.1).
bull: Q2 2026 (8-K, 2026-08-06) beat across revenue, EBITDA, margin and EPS; FY26 guidance raised to 10.0-10.1B revenue and 5.23-5.31 Adj EPS; 10 of 10 analyst actions in 90d were raises, median target +7.2%.
bear: Price momentum is negative (21d -13.7%, 63d -13.5%) with 38% vol and no news in 30 days; margin and gross-margin data are null; the 2B gas-turbine target is a 2028-2031 promise, unverified, and capex must rise.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results (about November 2026): Adjusted EBITDA margin below roughly 32%, or FY2026 Adjusted EPS guidance cut below 5.23, or revenue below the 10.0B low end.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 30d: no new company release since the 2026-08-26 Jefferies notice on Howmet IR; sell-side kept moving (2026-09-15 Guggenheim initiates Buy 350; 2026-09-14 BofA reiterates Buy 350, stockanalysis.com). 90d: 2026-08-06 Q2 2026 beat, revenue 2.55B up 24%, FY2026 guidance raised to revenue 10.0-10.1B and Adj EPS 5.23-5.31 (8-K ex99.1).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Gas Turbines revenue of about 1B in 2025 is guided to exceed 2B within 3 to 5 years, driven by data-center power demand, disclosed 2026-03-10 (SEC TMD ex99.1). On 2026-08-06 management said capex must increase again in 2027 to support organic growth, implying 2027 above current models (8-K). Commercial transportation recovery began Q1 2026.
web_demand_product: Demand comes from patented single-crystal and directionally solidified turbine airfoils with advanced cooling and coatings for jet engines and industrial gas turbines, plus aerospace fasteners (CAM, Brunner) and forged aluminum truck wheels, per 2026-03-10 Technology and Markets Day (SEC ex99.1) and 2026-08-06 results (8-K ex99.1).
web_price_volume_mix: Volume-led. Q2 2026 revenue rose 24% with organic growth 21%, driven by commercial aerospace plus 28%, gas turbines plus 38% and defense plus 11% (2026-08-06, 8-K ex99.1). Forged Wheels is the exception: revenue plus 14% on aluminum and inflation pass-through despite 8% lower commercial transportation volumes (2026-08-06, 8-K).
web_bottleneck: Airfoil casting, core, coating and tooling capacity. Howmet is expanding casting, core and coating capacity across about 30 sites (2026-03-10 TMD, SEC ex99.1) and says capex must rise again in 2027 to support organic growth (2026-08-06, 8-K). It relieves engine OEM build-rate limits and gas-turbine power bottlenecks.
web_who_benefits_next: Aircraft and engine OEMs, gas-turbine power and data-center operators, and defense primes benefit from Howmet capacity. F-35 is about 45% of defense aero revenue and total defense revenue was 1.5B, up 21% YoY (2026-03-10 TMD, SEC ex99.1). CAM and Brunner add fastener scale (2026-08-06, 8-K).
web_who_loses: Competing casting, fastener and forged-wheel suppliers lose share if Howmet capacity scales. Howmet exited lower-margin work such as the Savannah disk forging facility, leaving Engineered Structures revenue down 13% (2026-08-06, 8-K ex99.1). Engine OEMs lose bargaining power on sole-source patented airfoils (2026-03-10 TMD).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Aluminum and inflation pass-through in Forged Wheels, ramp and mix inefficiency from new capacity and CAM absorption, a prolonged commercial transportation trough, and tariff or trade disruption, all flagged as risks (2026-08-06, 8-K ex99.1). Q2 2026 Adjusted EBITDA margin was 32.1%; a slide toward 30% would signal erosion.
web_low_cost_substitute: Not found. Howmet calls itself the largest gas-turbine blade manufacturer in the world with patented single-crystal, cooling and coating technology (2026-03-10 TMD, SEC ex99.1). Chinese fastener and forging suppliers exist but aerospace OEM qualification is the barrier; no qualified low-cost airfoil substitute was identified.
web_ceo_promised: 2026-08-06 John Plant: we already see the need to increase capex further in 2027 to support future organic growth, and guided FY2026 revenue 10.0-10.1B and Adjusted EPS 5.23-5.31 (8-K ex99.1). 2026-03-10: gas turbines to exceed 2B in the next 3 to 5 years (SEC TMD ex99.1).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. 2026-08-06: revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA margin and Adjusted EPS all exceeded the high end of guidance (8-K ex99.1). CAM closed 2026-04-06 versus the first-half 2026 promise (2026-08-06, 8-K). FY2025 revenue rose 11% near the about 10% guidance and Free Cash Flow was 1.43B (2026-02-12, 8-K).
web_what_would_falsify: Q3 2026 results due about November 2026: Adjusted EBITDA margin below roughly 32%, or FY2026 Adjusted EPS guidance cut below 5.23, or revenue below the 10.0B low end (2026-08-06 guidance 8-K). Also falsifying: no progress toward 2B gas-turbine revenue by 2028, or 2027 capex guidance not increasing.
